#   ConfigServer Threat Database › SIP › 365 Days
#   Session Initiation Protocol
#   
#   These blocklists are maintained directly by ConfigServer and are
#   compiled from connection attempts against our SIP honeypots, as
#   well as unauthorized access attempts targeting VoIP services we
#   operate.
#   
#   The threat feeds capture malicious SIP activity across exposed
#   internet-facing VoIP infrastructure, including automated scanners,
#   enumeration tools, and brute force attempts against SIP endpoints.
#   
#   IP addresses included in this dataset have been observed attempting
#   actions such as SIP registration brute forcing, extension probing,
#   credential stuffing, and automated scanning of VoIP services.
#   
#   Blocklists prefixed with `_1d` represent activity observed within
#   the most recent 24-hour period and reflect confirmed SIP connection
#   attempts during that window, treated as high-confidence indicators
#   of malicious behavior.
#   
#   Blocklists prefixed with `_365d` are cumulative datasets covering
#   a one-year period and may include a higher rate of false positives
#   due to IP reuse, NAT, and infrastructure changes across providers.
